correctness: Frozen baseline complete result or exception class/message/order; unknown/inactive/malformed scope/document metadata/UTF-8, missing tables, deep/shared graphs, fresh mutable objects, document edits and correction between calls, overrides, direct autocommit/same-connection schema change.
